content: pnpm build-script gating: onlyBuiltDependencies (pnpm 9/10) is REMOVED in pnpm 11, replaced by allowBuilds — a map in pnpm-workspace.yaml added in v10.26.0 supporting version-scoped matchers; pnpm approve-builds writes there. strictDepBuilds (v10.3.0, default true) fails install on unreviewed build scripts; dangerouslyAllowAllBuilds (v10.9.0) exists. pnpm-v10-to-v11 codemod migrates. Source: pnpm.io/settings/build fetched 2026-09-10.
